name: Civilization
overview: Scripture reveals that true civilization is founded on the praise of God and the pursuit of His wisdom, as wisdom calls out and understanding speaks to guide human hearts (Psalms 147:1; Proverbs 8:1). The Lord directs the plans and words of people, underscoring that human progress depends on His sovereign guidance rather than human strength alone (Proverbs 16:1). A peaceful and secure habitation, marked by quiet rest, is a blessing for God's people and a sign of His favor (Isaiah 32:18). Furthermore, God raises leaders and opens gates of opportunity to subdue nations according to His will, demonstrating His control over the rise and stability of civilizations (Isaiah 45:1). The warning against folly, such as being deceived by strong drink, highlights the necessity of wisdom for a thriving society (Proverbs 20:1).
